title: The Complete Drop Shuffler
description: Drops reshuffle automatically on a timer. Choose 1, 5, or 10 minutes. Countdown bossbar visible to all players.
body:
# The Complete Drop Shuffler

Drops never stay the same for long. A bossbar counts down to the next reshuffle - when it hits zero, the whole drop pool changes and every player gets an announcement. Set the timer to 1, 5, or 10 minutes, depending on how much chaos you want.

## Features
- **Automatic reshuffle** on a timer - 1, 5, or 10 minute intervals
- **Bossbar countdown** visible to all players at all times
- **256 possible drop configurations** - reroll as many times as you want
- **Block, mob, and fishing drops** are all reshuffled
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things
4. Run `/function autoshuffle:set_1min`, `/function autoshuffle:set_5min` or `/function autoshuffle:set_10min` to set the interval

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
